admission.justification: Spans generation folders and canonical notes: fsync before validation, atomic replace, and source-preserving failure are the mechanisms behind FAM-2BRZW7's collect-before-remove guarantee.

applicability: Every collection that copies role reports to canonical notes before folder removal.
conditions: Copied-temp data is fsynced before source and readback validation.
exclusions: Silent source loss on failure; failure preserves the source and the folder.
statement: Report copies reach canonical notes before folders are removed; copied-temp data is fsynced before source/readback validation and atomic_replace, and failure preserves the source/report folder.
